title.narrative: Reaching the Inaccessible: Supporting Access to Justice for Women and Girls with Disabilities
Reaching the Inaccessible: Supporting Access to Justice for Women and Girls with Disabilities

description.narrative: AMER is working to improve access to legal services for women and girls with disabilities in seven Turkish provinces. The project will focus on training lawyers and strengthening the capacity of bar associations to provide legal support and representation to these individuals.

AMER is working to improve access to legal services for women and girls with disabilities in seven Turkish provinces. The project will focus on training lawyers and strengthening the capacity of bar associations to provide legal support and representation to these individuals.
